latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of distribution-boundary-designer: a skill for evaluating and designing service boundaries in distributed systems.

- Guides decision-making on whether to distribute, where to place service boundaries, and how to design Remote Facade and DTOs.
- Applies Fowler’s First Law of Distributed Object Design to filter unnecessary distribution.
- Identifies anti-patterns such as distribution-by-class and domain logic in remote shells.
- Helps select interface style (gRPC, REST, message queue, GraphQL) based on use case.
- Suitable for architects and senior engineers when considering microservices, extracting services, or evaluating remote APIs.
- Operates on descriptive input; codebase and diagrams are helpful but not required.
